title: NgRx 22: Resource Extensions and Dynamic Deep Signals for Angular
partialText: <img src="https://res.infoq.com/news/2026/10/ngrx-22-angular/en/headerimage/generatedHeaderImage-1792664456149.jpg"/><p>NgRx 22 adds experimental resource extensions that change Angular's resource behavior, so value() is retained during reloads and no longer throws on errors. It also introduces dynamic deep signals for union types, a SignalStoreFeatureType utility, and ESLint v10 support. Upgrading requires Angular 22 and TypeScript 6.0, and most breaking changes have automated migrations.</p> <i>By Daniel Curtis</i>

title: NestJS 12: ESM Packages, Standard Schema Validation and Native Observability
partialText: <img src="https://res.infoq.com/news/2026/10/nestjs-12-observability/en/headerimage/generatedHeaderImage-1792168374584.jpg"/><p>NestJS version 12 has been released, transitioning core packages to ESM and adding Standard Schema validation. It updates the CLI and introduces an observability SDK. Key changes include project generation choices between CJS and ESM, improved validation options, and lifecycle project hooks. Users will need Node.js 20.19+ or 22.12+. Migration guides are available for upgrading.</p> <i>By Daniel Curtis</i>

title: Zod Brings In-Process Schema Compilation and a 9x Cut in Memory Footprint
partialText: <img src="https://res.infoq.com/news/2026/10/zod-schema-compliation/en/headerimage/generatedHeaderImage-1792163115814.jpg"/><p>Zod is a TypeScript-focused schema validation library that recently released versions 4.5 and 4.6. Key updates include schema compilation for faster data parsing, significant memory usage reductions, and new validation features. The library supports efficient validation processes and remains popular in the JavaScript ecosystem, achieving millions of downloads weekly.</p> <i>By Daniel Curtis</i>

title: Cloudflares Newly Acquired Vite+ Reaches 1.0 with GitLab CI Support, Hooks, and tsup Migration
partialText: <img src="https://res.infoq.com/news/2026/10/cloudflare-viteplus-stable/en/headerimage/generatedHeaderImage-1791892196672.jpg"/><p>VoidZero has launched Vite+ 1.0, the first stable version of its JavaScript toolchain. It features a command line tool for managing Node.js, package management, and frontend development from a single configuration file. Enhancements include CI integration for GitLab and Docker support. Future updates are planned, focusing on stability and diagnostics.</p> <i>By Daniel Curtis</i>
